description: Track PFAS supplier inquiries by part count to show response coverage, outstanding follow-ups and how many suppliers reported PFAS, as a dated due-diligence log. Use this tested BusCalc worksheet when the task matches its inputs and scope. Returns named results, units, formula, assumptions, method version, reference-value notes (official figure or your figure, with source and effective date), a check link and a source-page URL. Official reference values are prefilled when omitted; supply every other figure from the user's records. Percent fields take percent numbers. No figures are looked up; no private projects or purchases are accessed. Put tool fields inside inputs. Supply units or modelVersion only when listed in inputSchema. Follow its required fields and exact choices. Do not pass the REST calculator field inside MCP arguments.

followAfter.description: Follow up when no full response after (your policy) (days). Your own follow-up interval; the example is illustrative.

inquiries.description: Supplier inquiry records. Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for supplier inquiry records. Unknown is not the same as zero.

followDay.description: Follow-up sent on day (0 if none) (day). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for follow-up sent on day (0 if none). Unknown is not the same as zero.

label.description: Reference label (no names needed). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for reference label (no names needed). Unknown is not the same as zero. Optional reference label; no names or personal data.

parts.description: Part numbers covered (parts). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for part numbers covered. Unknown is not the same as zero.

reported.description: PFAS reported by supplier. Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for pfas reported by supplier. Unknown is not the same as zero. Options: yes = Yes, PFAS reported; no = No PFAS reported; unknown = Not stated or pending.

response.description: Response received. Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for response received. Unknown is not the same as zero. Options: yes = Yes, complete; partial = Partial; no = No.

sentDay.description: Inquiry sent on day (day). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for inquiry sent on day. Unknown is not the same as zero.

today.description: Today's day number (day). Use the same day count as the rows (for example day 0 = the day you started the inquiry campaign).

modelVersion.description: Optional expected method version; a mismatch is rejected.

name: buscalc_pfas_supplier_inquiry_coverage_log

checkURL.description: Link that replays this calculation on https://buscalc.com/sumtru/verify/. Null when the inputs hold free-form text or the link would be too long.

notes.description: Reference-value notes first, then model notes and the standard limit statement.

referenceValues.description: One entry per official reference value in play: the official figure, the figure used, status official or user, source, effective date and the note text.

sealURL.description: Where a saved record of this result can be sealed with an independent timestamp.

title: PFAS supplier inquiry coverage log
